result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion. However, it goes beyond the playbook by applying return and deletion obligations to all Works and Confidential Information, not just Company Data. Requiring delivery of all Works upon any expiry or termination also expands the original Works-in-progress obligation, which applied only to breach termination, and may alter unrelated IP and deliverables arrangements. References to returning Confidential Information in machine-readable form and deleting “such materials” are also overbroad and potentially impractical.
